spans.s: ऐच् short term ( प्रत्याहार ) standing for 'the two diphthong vowels ऐ and औ; cf. न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्यां पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच्
, The short substitutes of ऐ and औ are इ and उ when prescribed cf.
; so also the protracted forms of ऐ and औ are protracted इ and उ; cf.
. They are called द्विस्वर vowels in the Ṛk Prātiś- ākhya. Śākaṭāyana says they are द्विमात्र.
